purpose: A driveable backlog: every NEEDS_MANUAL_SEAM the moderniser produced, categorized and assigned the modernisation DISPOSITION it would receive under the interactive-advisor model (MODERNISER_DESIGN L11 / §6.11). Today these are seals; under the advisor they become recommended, operator-approved transforms. This turns 'sealed, go figure it out' into 'here is what to do with each, by strategy'.

honest_note: The heavy 'retire' + 're_architect' share is a property of THIS corpus (a SAP-GUI/OS/RFC file manager is mostly boundary code). A business app would skew to 'refactor'. See the greenfield re-architecture demo (../zapcommander-rearchitected-2026-07-29/) for what the 're_architect' disposition actually generates: RAP+CDS+OData+Fiori at 0 seams, Level A.
